source.description: Synthetic CDR (Call Detail Record) parquet, partitioned by ingest_date

models.description: Bronze: deduped account-level register derived from CDR caller msisdn
models.sql:
{{ config(materialized='view') }}

with caller_first_seen as (
    select
        caller_msisdn,
        min(start_time) as first_event_at,
        plan_id,
        market
    from {{ ref('br_cdr') }}
    group by caller_msisdn, plan_id, market
)
select
    {{ generate_surrogate_key(['caller_msisdn']) }} as account_key,
    caller_msisdn,
    plan_id,
    market,
    first_event_at
from caller_first_seen

models.description: Bronze: typed CDR rows straight off the raw parquet landing
models.sql:
{{ config(materialized='view') }}

select
    cdr_id,
    caller_msisdn,
    nullif(callee_msisdn, '') as callee_msisdn,
    cast(start_time as timestamp) as start_time,
    cast(duration_sec as integer) as duration_sec,
    cast(bytes_used as bigint) as bytes_used,
    upper(call_type) as call_type,
    upper(market) as market,
    plan_id,
    cast(is_roaming as boolean) as is_roaming,
    cast(ingest_date as date) as ingest_date
from {{ source('raw', 'cdr_raw') }}

models.description: Silver: per-account, per-day aggregate of billable usage
models.sql:
{{ config(materialized='table') }}

select
    caller_msisdn,
    plan_id,
    market,
    ingest_date,
    sum(billable_minutes) as billable_minutes,
    sum(billable_mb) as billable_mb,
    count(*) filter (where call_type = 'VOICE') as voice_events,
    count(*) filter (where call_type = 'SMS') as sms_events,
    count(*) filter (where call_type = 'DATA') as data_events,
    sum(case when is_roaming then 1 else 0 end) as roaming_events
from {{ ref('sl_cdr_clean') }}
group by 1, 2, 3, 4

models.description: Silver: cleaned CDR with billable_minutes / billable_mb derived
models.sql:
{{ config(materialized='table') }}

with src as (
    select * from {{ ref('br_cdr') }}
)
select
    cdr_id,
    caller_msisdn,
    callee_msisdn,
    start_time,
    duration_sec,
    case when call_type = 'VOICE' then ceil(duration_sec / 60.0) else 0 end as billable_minutes,
    bytes_used,
    round(bytes_used / 1048576.0, 3) as billable_mb,
    call_type,
    market,
    plan_id,
    coalesce(is_roaming, false) as is_roaming,
    ingest_date
from src
where caller_msisdn is not null
  and duration_sec >= 0
  and call_type in ('VOICE', 'SMS', 'DATA')

models.description: Silver: per-event revenue breakdown used by gold marts
models.sql:
{{ config(materialized='table') }}

select
    cdr_id,
    caller_msisdn,
    plan_id,
    market,
    ingest_date,
    start_time,
    call_type,
    case
        when call_type = 'VOICE' then billable_minutes * 0.05
        when call_type = 'DATA'  then billable_mb * 0.02
        when call_type = 'SMS'   then 0.01
        else 0.0
    end as revenue_usd,
    is_roaming
from {{ ref('sl_cdr_clean') }}

{{ config(materialized='table') }}

with per_caller as (
    select
        caller_msisdn,
        plan_id,
        date_trunc('month', start_time) as month,
        sum(revenue_usd) as revenue_usd
    from {{ ref('sl_revenue_event') }}
    group by 1, 2, 3
)
select
    month,
    plan_id,
    avg(revenue_usd) as arpu_usd,
    count(*) as active_callers
from per_caller
group by 1, 2

{{ config(materialized='table') }}

with per_caller as (
    select
        caller_msisdn,
        max(ingest_date) as last_active_date,
        sum(voice_events + sms_events + data_events) as events_30d,
        sum(roaming_events) as roaming_events
    from {{ ref('sl_account_daily') }}
    group by 1
)
select
    caller_msisdn,
    last_active_date,
    events_30d,
    roaming_events,
    case
        when events_30d <= 1 then 'high'
        when events_30d <= 5 then 'medium'
        else 'low'
    end as churn_risk
from per_caller

models.description: Gold: daily revenue rollup by market for FP&A
models.sql:
{{ config(materialized='table') }}

select
    market,
    ingest_date,
    sum(revenue_usd) as revenue_usd,
    count(*) as event_count,
    count(distinct caller_msisdn) as active_callers
from {{ ref('sl_revenue_event') }}
group by 1, 2
